questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the road or driveway ahead. You must turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards and changes ahead. This sign warns that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on a green light. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a parking limit. You can only park for a maximum of two hours during the times posted on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep hill or downgrade coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces in parking lots. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from the right is merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no right turns are allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. A new, lower speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at a low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means no U-turns are allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn of a school nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians crossing the road. Follow any instructions from crossing guards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers turning left on green that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you to stay to the right of an island, median, or barrier ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal shows it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: A curve is ahead in the direction shown by the arrow. Driving at 35 mph or slower is recommended for this curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light, slow for a yellow light, or proceed on a green light. Also watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle, and low-clearance vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows that there are multiple lanes available for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The eight-sided stop sign means you must stop completely and yield the right-of-way. You may proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a shared center lane for left turns from both directions. Use this lane only to turn left. Do not use it as a regular driving lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns that maintenance work is happening ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On horizontal signals, red is always on the left and green on the right.
